note: Title II of the Social Security Act, under which the Social Security Administration assigns Social Security numbers, counts the United States Virgin Islands as a State and as part of the United States (42 U.S.C. § 410(h), (i), as govinfo holds the 2023 edition, read 2026-10-30), so its people hold the United States' Social Security number. The number's own terms are the United States file's.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition, 42 U.S.C. § 410 (Social Security Act, title II, definitions)
sources.said: The term "State" includes the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, Guam, and American Samoa. ... The term "United States" when used in a geographical sense means the States, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, Guam, and American Samoa.
